assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D fantasy game UI portrait frame overlay for Rabbit Lands.
Input image 1 is the approved leaderboard concept and is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create only the isolated portrait medallion artwork, not the full interface.
Identity and silhouette: one large circular beveled metal portrait rim, a balanced broad laurel wreath hugging both lower sides, and a SMALL BLANK heraldic shield at the bottom overlapping the ring. The central round aperture must be completely transparent so a real player portrait can show through. All exterior negative space must also be transparent. The shield is opaque and EMPTY, for a rank number added at runtime.
Composition: square canvas, straight-on, symmetric. The circular opening is centered horizontally at x=50%, y=43% of the canvas, opening radius 28% of canvas width. Circle rim outer radius 32%. The laurel leaves extend to x=7% and x=93% at widest, with their tips near y=25%, and stems meeting just above the bottom shield. The small shield occupies x=39% to 61%, y=71% to 94%. Keep at least 4% safe margin at every outermost edge. No shadow or background inside the hole.
Style/materials: faithful to the approved concept, sculpted hand-painted matte metal, chunky intentional leaves, clean readable bevels, broad highlights, low-frequency painted shading, fine dark inset trim, restrained elegant flourishes. Rich professional fantasy MMORPG asset, tactile and dimensional, not simplistic flat vector clipart. No gemstone, skull, crown, face, character, portrait, initials, text, numeral, watermark, scenery, card, or rectangular frame. The center and surrounding background are actual transparent alpha, not a checkerboard illustration.

Material variation: Warm aged GOLD, shaded bronze recesses and honey-gold bevel highlights, for the first-place champion.
assets.review: Transparent center and exterior verified; empty shield supports the runtime rank label. Painted metal and laurel framing match the approved direction.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: wide atmospheric background artwork for the upper region of a Rabbit Lands leaderboard window.
The attached image is the approved UI concept, a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Recreate only its quiet dark midnight-blue fantasy battlement backdrop behind the three podium cards, with distant stone castle silhouettes, a few slender spears and hanging muted banners, soft painted haze, broad stylized shapes, subdued matte hand-painted fantasy-game rendering. Wide landscape composition about 2.7:1; architecture lives at the edges and along the top third, middle and lower two thirds mostly very dark charcoal navy negative space, readable and unobtrusive behind native controls. Subtle atmosphere, no dramatic highlights. Near-black corners blend into a charcoal interface. Match the concept's understated northern stronghold mood. No characters, faces, portraits, statues, podium, UI frames, medals, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark or controls. This is one continuous full-bleed background painting, no transparent background.
assets.review: Quiet painted battlement scene with dark lower negative space; matches the podium backdrop direction.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one reusable painted fantasy-game leaderboard champion CARD BACKGROUND texture for Rabbit Lands.
Image 1 is the approved podium interface STYLE REFERENCE. Image 2 is the approved silver portrait medallion style reference. Generate ONLY a clean EMPTY square card plate, dead front, filling the canvas, suitable behind native game UI controls.
Identity/silhouette: a rectangular subtly rounded dark stone-and-cloth plaque with a THIN sculpted aged-silver rim, elegant small acanthus corner flourishes, and a second recessed fine inner bevel. The central 85 percent must remain very dark, simple and EMPTY for readable overlaid portrait and score controls. Two extremely subdued woven-cloth banner shapes hang from the upper corners into the dark field, no symbols on them.
Materials: neutral desaturated SILVER-gunmetal rim so it can be tinted to gold or bronze by the UI; cool charcoal/navy-black matte hand-painted stone backing, subtle broad brush variation, sparse edge wear, readable bevel highlights. Restrained low-frequency detail like the reference concept, not noisy stone or photographic metal. All corners fully visible with a tiny 1 percent outer safe margin, no external drop shadow. Square texture, straight orthographic view, no perspective.
Presentation: this is a single full-bleed game UI texture, no scene or surrounding canvas. No medallion, portrait hole, person, face, icon, skull, coat of arms, gemstone, trophy, letters, numbers, words, watermark, logo, text, controls, mockup, sample UI or inset cards. The plaque is intentionally empty; all content is added at runtime. Background is opaque.
assets.review: Empty dark textured plaque with a thin sculpted silver rim and subdued banners. Runtime tint supplies gold, silver and bronze while native controls remain readable.
